import{useEffect}from'react';/**
 * Custom hook to dynamically set the document title
 * @param {string} title - The title to set for the page
 * @param {string} [prefix='Inventra'] - Optional prefix for the title
 */const usePageTitle=function(title){let prefix=arguments.length>1&&arguments[1]!==undefined?arguments[1]:'Inventra';useEffect(()=>{if(title){document.title="".concat(prefix," | ").concat(title);}else{document.title=prefix;}// Cleanup: reset to default title when component unmounts
return()=>{document.title=prefix;};},[title,prefix]);};export default usePageTitle;
